name: Overriding Control
text: The bearer's unit may shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. It still may not declare a charge that turn.

effect.name: Overriding Control
effect.text: The bearer's unit (attached unit included) can shoot after Falling Back.

name: Protocol of Resonant Focus
text: In your Command phase, choose one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer and visible to it. Until the end of the turn, each attack by a friendly NECRONS model against that unit re-rolls a hit roll of 1.

effect.name: Protocol of Resonant Focus
effect.text: Mark one enemy unit within 12" and visible to the bearer in your Command phase; friendly NECRONS attacks against it re-roll hit rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.
